# "baseline" environment — runs the official STHR code (Yuan et al., PVLDB 2022,
# github.com/yuanhaitao/STHR_CODE) exactly as released: code/Leim2.py and
# code/commonLayers.py are imported unmodified.
#
# Why a separate env: Leim2.py imports dgl._deprecate, which exists only up to
# DGL 1.0.1 (removed in 1.0.2), and DGL 1.0.x supports PyTorch <= 1.13.1.
# commonLayers.py uses np.float, removed in NumPy 1.24.
# Verified on Windows 11, RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (sm_89 runs the sm_86 kernels).
#
# Create:
#   conda create -n baseline python=3.9
#   conda activate baseline
#   pip install torch==1.13.1+cu117 --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu117
#   pip install dgl==1.0.1+cu117 -f https://data.dgl.ai/wheels/cu117/repo.html
#   pip install torch_scatter==2.1.1 torch_sparse==0.6.17 torch_geometric==2.3.1 -f https://data.pyg.org/whl/torch-1.13.1+cu117.html
#   pip install -r env/baseline_requirements.txt
#
# pyrosm is deliberately absent: it has no Windows wheel for Python 3.9 and the
# conda-forge build pulls NumPy 2. It is not needed here (loss_functions.py no
# longer imports it; it was an unused import).
#
# Run:  conda activate baseline
#       python main.py --blocks STHR --datasets porto --batch-size 64
#       python main.py --blocks Evaluation --datasets porto --eval-models STHR --batch-size 64

numpy==1.23.5
pandas==2.0.3
geopandas==0.14.4
shapely==2.0.6
pyproj==3.6.1
scipy==1.10.1
scikit-learn==1.6.1
PyYAML==6.0.2
tqdm
requests
networkx
folium==0.20.0
